title: Scripture and Restoration
definition: Scripture and restoration belong together because God's Word calls the fallen to repentance, offers hope in grace, and guides renewed obedience.
summary: God's Word exposes sin and leads repentant people toward restoration.
christFocus: Jesus restores broken sinners by grace and renews them for faithful life.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Restoration requires truth and grace. Scripture exposes sin honestly, but it also holds out mercy for the repentant and guidance for renewed obedience.

God's Word prevents restoration from becoming denial, excuse-making, or permanent shame. It shows the path of confession, forgiveness, accountability, and renewed faithfulness.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People who fail often either hide from truth or drown in shame. Scripture and restoration matters because God's Word gives a path back through repentance and grace.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Let Scripture name sin honestly and grace clearly. If you have fallen, confess, seek help, and take the next obedient step toward restoration.
